introHtml: Heat transfer decoration allows you to apply vibrant, full-color logos and intricate designs to custom coolers with exceptional detail. Unlike screen printing, heat transfer works well on curved surfaces and textured fabrics, making it ideal for soft-sided coolers, lunch bags, and insulated totes. This method produces a smooth, durable finish that resists peeling, even with frequent use and washing. For marketing directors and safety managers, heat transfer coolers offer a premium look that stands out at trade shows, corporate events, and job sites.
